description: Avoid single-character variable names — they hurt readability
Cache repeated database lookups inside the request loop
Never interpolate raw user input directly into SQL queries
Do not hardcode sensitive credentials API keys or tokens in source files
Avoid quadratic nested loops when linear lookups with sets or hash maps can be used
Escape or sanitize HTML output to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
Keep functions under 40 lines to follow the Single Responsibility Principle
Do not use wildcard imports; explicitly import required symbols
Use bulk database insertions or batch transactions instead of single row inserts
Do not pass untrusted shell commands to subprocess or system exec without validation
Ensure all opened file handles and network streams are closed using context managers
Avoid deep unmemoized recursion that can cause stack overflow or exponential time complexity
Do not catch broad generic Exception without logging or re-raising
Use cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generators for tokens and salts
Maintain consistent snake_case for Python and camelCase for JavaScript functions
Avoid unnecessary memory copies by using slices or iterators on large collections
Never disable TLS/SSL certificate verification in HTTP requests
Separate data access logic from HTTP request controllers
Check for null
column5: or None before accessing nested object properties

description: Use connection pooling for database clients rather than creating a connection per request
Validate and constrain file upload paths to prevent path traversal attacks
Avoid magic numbers; declare meaningful named constants
Prefer composition over inheritance for extensible component architecture
Debounce or throttle frequent event handlers like scroll or resize
Enforce rate limiting on authentication and password reset endpoints
Handle Promise rejections or async exceptions to prevent uncaught runtime crashes
Do not mutate function arguments in-place; return new transformed immutable states
Remove commented-out dead code and obsolete debug print statements before commit
Use appropriate data structures: O(1) hash maps vs O(n) linear array scans for frequent lookups
Set secure HttpOnly and SameSite flags on sensitive session cookies
Check array bounds or list length before index access to prevent out-of-range panic
Implement health check endpoints and structured JSON logging for observability
Leverage lazy loading and dynamic imports for non-critical modules
Do not log raw passwords
Include docstrings or type hints for public library interfaces and exported APIs
